maxVersionNote: 1.0.0 is the first release: stylesheets read the colour and font role variables themselves (role scan 0 open, DECISIONS D53); src/lib/ds-slot.ts and the layout load data/ds-slot.css as in Tracy Base. They do not read the type and shape tokens (--ds-weight-*, --ds-size-*, --ds-leading-display, --ds-tracking-display): global.css reads --ds-btn-radius, --ds-card-radius, --ds-input-radius and --ds-pill-radius in a few rules only, none of them the .rs-btn rule
applies: data/ds-slot.css read per request by src/lib/ds-slot.ts; the template reads every value as var(--ds-*, <its own value>)
readsRolesNote: src/styles/tokens.css and global.css read every standard role variable, or declare it unused with a reason (ds-not-used) or keep it (ds-keep)
modesNote: the light/dark switch (data-theme on html, [data-theme-toggle] in Header.astro)

contrast.heading: body :is(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6)
contrast.text: body :is(p, li, a, span, small, label, td, th, dd, dt, blockquote, figcaption, button)
contrast.block-text: body div:not(:has(> :is(div, p, ul, ol, section, article, header, footer, nav, main, aside, figure, table, form, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6)))

readyNote: not ready: measured 05/11/2026 on the released 1.0.0 (the published zip and state, served on Node; flow.mjs, the 15 featured systems at 1440 and 390; preview-check, 2 systems x light and dark x 40 pages, run with this file's ready set to true for the run only, because the preview door refuses a contract that is not ready): 29 of 45 rules pass. The colours, the page mode, the fonts, the logo and the undo follow the system; the display and heading weights and sizes, the body weight and the button and card radii stay the template's (ROLE-1), white text stays on the accent-coloured bands (CON-1), the second mode does not follow (MODE-2), and the preview finds colours of the template's own left (TPL-1 and the rules after it). DEF-1 belongs to the template: tokens.css reads --ds-c-secondary and --ds-c-on-ink-soft, which no system defines. Measurement: contracts/1.0.0/design-system-measurement.json
measureNote: the Reservation page embeds OpenTable's booking widget through a parser-blocking script; the measuring browser fails it at once (the widget paints with OpenTable's own stylesheet). Carousels (home slideshow, quotes) are stopped on their first slide before each measure
